entries.t: <FACE:09>This place gives me<NL>the creeps…
<FACE:0F>They hollowed out the<NL>asteroid…<WAIT>Must've dug it out for<NL>this base's material…
<FACE:00>So this base was built<NL>right here?<WAIT><FACE:03>Amazing…<WAIT><FACE:0F>Yeah… I took them for<NL>reckless show-offs…
<FACE:0F>Well now, seems they<NL>do have real tech…
<FACE:0F>A fork… Let's split up<NL>I'll look that way
<FACE:0A>Then I'll go this way
<FACE:19>I'll go the other way,<NL>sir
<FACE:05>We'll take this path!<NL>Let's go, <PLAYER>!<WAIT><FACE:03>Uh, Hiyori… what do<NL>you mean, we…?
<FACE:04>Hiyori always does<NL>just what she wants!
<FACE:05>With this mail-order…<NL>
<FACE:05>«Auto Dowsing Machine<NL>Dowsinger Z»! Easy!
<FACE:05>Look! Let's go where<NL>it's reacting!
<FACE:00>Hey, Hiyori…<NL><WAIT>Isn't dowsing for<NL>finding ore veins?<WAIT>Then where it reacts<NL>would be blocked up…
<FACE:06>Ugh! It's a dead end!<NL>
<FACE:06>I kind of felt that!<NL>Back we go, <PLAYER>
<FACE:05>Wonder what the others<NL>are up to? Go check!

<FACE:00>Shiden! What are you<NL>doing?<WAIT><FACE:0F>Hmmm…<NL><WAIT>An ultra-pure crystal<NL>of special metal…<WAIT>The asteroid's got<NL>amazing resources…<WAIT><FACE:00>Ugh! If you know it's<NL>a dead end, get back!
<FACE:00>Fubuki! What are you<NL>doing?
<FACE:0A>Ah… as a spy…<NL><WAIT>Gotta check if they<NL>left any codes behind<WAIT><FACE:00>This isn't some cheap<NL>mystery novel!<NL><WAIT>If you know it's a<NL>dead end, get back!
<FACE:0A>Hm? What's this?!
<FACE:03>Ah! Fubuki, that…<NL><WAIT>that's a dirty book…
<FACE:0D>Eek!
<FACE:80>That's mine-roboo!<NL>Middle schoolers<WAIT>mustn't see that-robo!
<FACE:03>Fubuki! What was that<NL>just now!?<WAIT><FACE:0B>Let's go after him!
<FACE:03>Huh? Hiyori?<NL>Why are you here?
<FACE:05>What do you mean, why…<NL><WAIT>Fubuki squealed, so I<NL>peeked: a Sperobo…<WAIT><FACE:00>Where did he go?<WAIT><FACE:09>Well…<NL>

<FACE:09>I was worried about<NL>you guys, that's all…<WAIT><FACE:05>Everything OK over<NL>there?<WAIT><FACE:00>Yeah, Fubuki just<NL>found a weird book…<NL><WAIT>But I see… I wish we<NL>knew where he went
<FACE:0A>Can't be helped<NL><WAIT>Anyway, it must lead<NL>somewhere…<WAIT>For now, let's regroup
<FACE:00>Mizore! What are you<NL>doing?
<FACE:1C>!<NL><WAIT>That's not it, sir…<NL><WAIT>I wasn't slacking off<NL>on a break, sir!<WAIT><FACE:01>…If you know it's a<NL>dead end, get back!
<FACE:00>Gousetsu! What are you<NL>doing?
<FACE:17>!<NL><WAIT>It ain't like that…<NL><WAIT>I wasn't slackin' off!<NL>Believe me, will ya!<WAIT><FACE:01>…If you know it's a<NL>dead end, get back!
<FACE:13>Strange, though…<NL>No path leads deeper…
<FACE:0D>Hm? This wall looks a<NL>little odd!?
<FACE:0A>It's a bit wobbly<NL>Rocks put here later?
<FACE:0F>So there's a passage<NL>on the other side…
<FACE:05>Let's just smash this<NL>with a Medaforce!
<FACE:05><PLAYER>!<NL>Go on, do it!
<FACE:12>No, that's a bad idea…
<FACE:0F>They dug deep here to<NL>get at the resources
<FACE:0F>It's structurally weak<NL>Slip up and it caves!
<FACE:04>Yeah… if only we could<NL>get them to open it…
<FACE:16>Somethin' like that?<NL>Leave it to me!
<FACE:17>Aaaaaaah!
<FACE:17>Scraped the wall a bit<NL>and out poured gold!
<FACE:17>It's a vein of gold!<NL>Look! A big gold bar!
<FACE:0B>There's no way a bar<NL>comes out of a vein!
<FACE:0F>Besides, the special<NL>metal from this vein<WAIT>is worth many times<NL>more than gold!
<FACE:05>I thought so too!<NL>So ignorant it hurts!<WAIT><FACE:1D>I misjudged you, sir!
<FACE:18>Guys… you don't have<NL>to go that fa…
<FACE:15>Ya didn't have to say<NL>that muuuuuch!!!
<FACE:18>Sniff… sob… sob…<NL>Then…<WAIT>Then I'm sure you lot<NL>have great ideas, eh!
<FACE:0E>…<NL><WAIT>(If I mess this up…)
<FACE:1D>(I'd end up just like<NL> Gousetsu did, sir…)
<FACE:10>(If they laugh at me,<NL> my cool image is…)
<FACE:03>What's with everyone?<NL>Suddenly so quiet…
<FACE:00>Hiyori! How do we<NL>lure them out?
<FACE:06>Quit bugging me… go<NL>ask somebody else!<WAIT><FACE:00>Don't say that, Hiyori<NL>You can lure them out<WAIT><FACE:06>Don't say things you<NL>can't back up!<NL>
<FACE:06>Besides, they're wimps<NL>who block off paths!
<FACE:06>By now they've run off<NL>somewhere far away!
<FACE:04>Wimps?
<FACE:06>What? Obviously!<NL><WAIT>If they had the skill,<NL>they'd Robattle us!<WAIT>They kept losing to us<NL>back in the Cluster<WAIT>They think they can't<NL>win, so they do this!
<FACE:00>No need to go this<NL>way…
